messages:
maria_cs: FYI we've received multiple customer reports in the last 3 hours saying retrieval+rerank quality dropped after last night's model push. Customers report missing authoritative docs in top results, absent citations, and lower recall. Latency unaffected.

sam_support: Can you drop one of the customers' repros and any request ids? We need something deterministic to pass to eng.

maria_cs: Customer X pasted this minimal repro (sanitized) and two request ids they observed. They say before the rollout the KB page 'Data Retention Policy' was consistently #1; now it doesn't appear in top 10. :frowning:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/search_rerank -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '\n{\n  "workflow": ["retrieve","rerank"],\n  "query": "How long do we retain transaction logs for compliance?",\n  "namespace": "custX-kb",\n  "retrieve": {"top_k": 60, "embed_model": "embed-lite-2024-03"},\n  "rerank": {"model": "reranker-v2.0", "top_k": 12}\n}\n'\n```

maria_cs: request ids: r_20240630_209 and r_20240630_214. They attached screenshots with expected doc ids (doc_42, doc_99).

aj_eng_ml: Quick context: reranker-v2.0 was trained with two config changes: stronger in-batch negatives and we stopped L2-normalizing candidate embeddings prior to dot-product. If the retrieval index stored normalized vectors, that mismatch would change similarity distributions. Our internal cross-validation did show drops on some corpora.

aj_eng_ml: Canary metrics from our initial rollout test set (enterprise holdout): MRR 0.60 -> 0.50, Recall@10 0.85 -> 0.70. Directionally matches these customer tickets.

ravi_runtime: Also note we had an index rebuild job that completed for a subset of namespaces around the same time. Need to verify whether affected customers hit pre- or post-rebuild indexes (norm vs raw). Mixed semantics could amplify the issue.

sam_support: Action checklist for support: 1) capture full request/response for reported request ids (asked customers for logs) 2) confirm embedding model & index timestamp 3) whether customer on hosted vs dedicated 4) confirm customer-perceived regression examples.

maria_cs: Customer X is hosted. Their payload shows embed-lite-2024-03. Namespace last indexed: 2024-06-29T22:50:00Z, which is before reranker-v2.0 deploy at 2024-06-30T01:02:14Z.

aj_eng_ml: That timing strongly suggests normalization mismatch: reranker-v2.0 expects raw (unnormalized) candidate vectors. If index contains L2-normalized vectors, dot-products compress scores. We'll reproduce by scoring same candidates with v1.4 and v2.0 using both normalized and raw vectors.

ravi_runtime: Repro steps from infra: 1) snapshot sanitized namespace -> build local index mirroring prod (normalized vectors) 2) run retrieve(top_k=60) to capture candidate list 3) run reranker-v1.4 vs reranker-v2.0 and compare scores/rankings 4) collect diffs (top-10 mismatches).

aj_eng_ml: Minimal python diff snippet (replace ... with candidates payload):

```
import requests
payload = {"query": "How long do we retain transaction logs for compliance?", "candidates": [...]} 
r1 = requests.post('https://internal-rerank/api/score', json={**payload, 'model':'reranker-v1.4'}).json()
r2 = requests.post('https://internal-rerank/api/score', json={**payload, 'model':'reranker-v2.0'}).json()
print('v1 top', [c['id'] for c in sorted(r1['scores'], key=lambda x: -x['score'])[:10]])
print('v2 top', [c['id'] for c in sorted(r2['scores'], key=lambda x: -x['score'])[:10]])
```

lina_am: I'm tracking Customer X as P2. They'll escalate contract contacts if we don't have mitigation in 24h. Need a short-term plan.

aj_eng_ml: Short-term mitigations: A) quick patch to reranker-v2.0 to L2-normalize candidates before scoring (fast change) B) route affected customers to reranker-v1.4 via per-customer routing flags (low-risk rollback).

ravi_runtime: Routing flip is the fastest for a small group. We have per-account routing in the config store. If AMs give IDs, ops can flip and monitor. Also starting additional tracing on reranker service for those accounts to capture full responses.

maria_cs: Affected IDs: custX_101, custY_207. I'll DM approvals.
\ravi_runtime: deploybot: reranker-v2.0 deployed at 2024-06-30T01:02:14Z. Rebuild jobs for indices ran 2024-06-29T20:45:00Z - 2024-06-30T00:10:00Z.

ravi_runtime: Routing flags updated: custX_101 & custY_207 routed to reranker-v1.4 at 2024-06-30T09:07:12Z. Monitoring dashboards enabled.

maria_cs: Customer X confirmed better results after routing flip; their policy doc returned to top 3. They sent screenshots, thanked support. :relieved:

sam_support: Post-incident action items (assigned):
- aj_eng_ml: reproduce at scale, produce full A/B metrics (MRR/Recall@k) across expanded enterprise corpora, root cause doc, ETA EOD.
- eng-ml + eng-runtime: either add L2-normalization inside reranker-v2.0 hotfix or ensure training+serving embedding contract enforced; implement guard tests.
- product_qc: expand canary dataset to include enterprise KBs and citation recall checks in pre-rollout suite.
- lina_am: keep customers informed, assess SLA/customer impact.

aj_eng_ml: I'll upload evaluation artifacts and a top-10 mismatch diff to this thread when ready. Also proposing to add a synthetic "citation recall" benchmark to every reranker rollout checklist.

maria_cs: Keeping this thread open until we have the eng postmortem and preventive checklist items. Attaching customer screenshots & sanitized samples to the ticket.
